item.text:
# Workspace opportunity review

**Evaluation date:** October 26, 2026

## Finding 1: A small take-home bean growing trial may be actionable

**Evidence:** Greenbank Community Room reports that families want a low-cost balcony growing activity with visual instructions, but says “nothing is commissioned” ([01-mail/2026-10-branch.txt](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/01-mail/2026-10-branch.txt)). A manager note allows “up to four existing staff hours and unallocated office supplies” for one internal trial if approved ([07-operations/limits.txt](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/07-operations/limits.txt)). The October 8 stocktake lists 180 small envelopes and 90 labels as unallocated ([02-stock/supplies.json](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/02-stock/supplies.json)). The stock list records 240 seeds from BX19, common bean, harvested in 2026 ([02-stock/stock-list.csv](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/02-stock/stock-list.csv)); a committee minute permits staff to prepare and share small non-commercial samples from BX19, “subject to manager approval and a viability check” ([04-rights/lot-disposition.txt](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/04-rights/lot-disposition.txt)). Prior notes describe observing beans in clear cups with moist paper, while cautioning they provide no success-rate guarantee ([03-research/packet-notes.txt](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/03-research/packet-notes.txt)). A staff-created template allows internal adaptation, but it is a water-saving notice, “not a planting guide” ([06-design/template.json](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/06-design/template.json), [06-design/inventory.md](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/06-design/inventory.md)).

**Assessment:** This is a plausible internal trial opportunity, not an established program or committed external activity.

**Missing information and restrictions:** BX19 has no recorded germination test ([02-stock/condition-log.txt](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/02-stock/condition-log.txt)). The branch has no instructor or current purchase budget, and no outside funding, order, or partner participation is committed. The approval and viability check are explicit prerequisites; available staff time is not allocated yet.

**Safe next actions:** Seek manager approval for a bounded internal trial; test a small BX19 sample for viability; confirm actual supply counts and staff-hour allocation; draft simple visual instructions and assess whether users understand them before sharing any samples.

## Finding 2: Check the envelope printer as a possible way to label trial packets

**Evidence:** An October 15 service note says the manual envelope label printer is working and “One trained volunteer can show staff its use” ([05-equipment/desk-log.txt](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/05-equipment/desk-log.txt)). The supplies stocktake includes unallocated small envelopes and adhesive labels ([02-stock/supplies.json](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/02-stock/supplies.json)).

**Assessment:** The printer may support packet preparation if the trial proceeds, but no document confirms label compatibility, envelope dimensions, or current access to the trained volunteer.

**Missing information and restrictions:** The listed envelope size measurement sheet was not found, and “No measurements are available here” ([07-operations/missing-register.txt](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/07-operations/missing-register.txt)). An older note says the printer is not a laboratory instrument ([05-equipment/desk-log.txt](/tmp/ugreen05-benchmark-qyi7a92s/a-g2/workspace/05-equipment/desk-log.txt)).

**Safe next actions:** Locate or recreate the size measurements, confirm the printer and volunteer are available, and test one label on an envelope before planning a batch.

## Records reviewed and limits

I inspected all 39 listed non-archive files across the eight workspace folders. The inventory contained no archive files, so there was no archive content to open. I did not access files outside the workspace, use web search or external data, or modify files.

The review is limited to the contents present in this workspace. In particular, the missing sleeve-size sheet, unrecorded BX19 viability, and unallocated staff hours prevent treating either opportunity as ready for execution.
